Wow 🤩 With LEGO bricks, Andrzej Łukomski turns cooking into a creative playground. This Polish stop-motion animator brings miniature food scenes to life using frame-by-frame animation: carefully moving each piece and capturing hundreds of photos to create the illusion of movement. Behind just a few seconds of animation lie hours of patience and precision.
